title.narrative: Support to LIFE-AR Year 1 Establishment Phase

description.narrative: Climate responses have often been defined and led externally and not by the LDCs, limiting opportunities for long-term capacity building and the building of LDC systems. To overcome these pressing challenges, the LDC Group launched their 2050 Vision for a climate-resilient future: for LDCs to be on climate-resilient development pathways by 2030 and deliver net-zero emissions by 2050. LIFE-AR (LDC Initiative for Effective Adaptation and Resilience) will serve as one of the primary vehicles for driving the LDC Vision forward ensuring climate action is in-line with LDC needs and priorities.This grant ensures support to the LIFE-AR Technical Lead to continue to technically lead the initiative and provide guidance to partners during Year 1 establishment phase.
